items.title: Albert "June" Gardner Interview, 1996-04-17
items.q: Yeah, I would go with Jack.

ctx.x: I sit right there and listen to all of it. Not only him, Toots Washington used to stop by. Toots? Yeah, Papa Yellow. Yeah, he touched. Yeah, that was my man, God bless him. And all of these guys, like I said, they had a smile and lures. I was very young and these guys would come and get me and it was an experience. And they all tell my mother, they'd take care of me. We used to go like the slide out, we'd make three dollars, five dollars for that night. Not be a child, you know, with these men. But they would all…
You would go with Champion Jack? Yeah, I would go with Jack.
It was really like the slide out of the home within the neighboring town. So yeah. Like I said, they would all look out for June and I appreciate it. But it was.
